description: Simulated yields and water use for alternative crop varieties and sowing dates worldwide. The Scientific Data paper (3 April 2026) says the dataset gives simulated yields and consumptive water use for multiple varieties and sowing dates of maize, soybean, winter and spring wheat and rice, from the WOFOST crop model driven by five global climate models and three greenhouse gas scenarios at 0.5 degree resolution for 1961 to 2100, using GGCMI crop calendars and WOFOST crop parameters. The full dataset is hosted on the YODA repository and scripts are on GitHub, free to download; the paper is under CC BY. Coverage is global croplands. Caveats: results come from one crop model and simulated growing conditions. For simulation it shows how shifting sowing dates or varieties could keep yields and irrigation water use stable under warming, for adaptation planning. A related catalogue record is the DiffWOFOST differentiable crop model.
